notes.title: 10 year anniversary gift!
notes.notes: [p]It's already been 10 years since the release of Kiai Resonance. To celebrate the anniversary, I have a little surprise: cheat codes! They've never been found (that I know of) so I'll reveal one each day this week. 👺[/p][p][/p][p]To find out about them, either go to Absorb Reality's Twitter page, or the discussion page on the Kiai Resonance Steam forum.[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/360450/discussions/0/605290750430786935/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/360450/discussions/0/605290750430786935/[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/AbsorbReality"]https://x.com/AbsorbReality[/url][/p]

notes.title: New Title and new discount
notes.notes:
From the developer of Kiai Resonance (it's me), Divine Ascent now available on Steam!

Developed by Absorb Reality, Divine Ascent is a turn-based game, in a board game style with simple but addictive rules. The goal is to be the first to place three temples.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/606300/

To celebrate this new title, Kiai Resonance is 75% off on Steam for a week.

notes.title: Game on sale / Tournament reminder
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.

There are still a few days to register for next week's Kiai Resonance tournament, where you can win free games from Flying Interactive. Plus, the game is currently on sale, so it's a good opportunity to invite all your friends to compete.

Simply follow [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/360450/announcements/detail/157971310116799438]this link[/url] to register.

notes.title: Kiai Resonance tournament
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

We are organizing the first Kiai Resonance tournament next week, which will start on June 15th. If you would like to participate, please comment under this announcement and state the name you use on the Kiai Resonance online mode (with ranking).

The winners will receive free games from Flying Interactive*:

- 1st place: 5 of the Flying Interactive games on Steam
- 2nd place: 3 of the Flying Interactive games on Steam
- 3rd place: 1 of the Flying Interactive games on Steam

We hope to see many participants!

* The games which you can win include: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/363410/]Always the Same Blue Sky...[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/377760/]Fox & Flock[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/326720/]Instant Dungeon![/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/342350/]Into The Gloom[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/360450/]Kiai Resonance[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/364480/]Red Goblin: Cursed Forest[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/375720/]Tuk Ruk[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/340570/]WolfWars[/url].

Note: Winners will choose their prizes from the game list above.
